message.content: {"SuprNova.org": ["SuprNova.org was the largest BitTorrent link site globally, hosting both authorized and unauthorized files.", "The site's location in Slovenia was generally considered invulnerable to American copyright enforcement actions."], "Sloncek": ["Sloncek, the 18-year-old owner, decided to voluntarily close the site's links section.", "The closure was triggered by news of admin arrests and received legal warnings."]}
